summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its interim financial statements and MD&A for Q2 2026, as a foreign private issuer under cover of Form 6-K. The filing references routine updates to streaming, royalty, and prepaid gold interests across multiple assets, including a gold stream on the Ravenswood gold mine and settlement agreements with Steppe Gold. It does not announce a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer; rather, it is a standard periodic report detailing operational and financial results. No board recommendation, deal terms, or strategic review process is mentioned.
